title: Discovery, pricing, handoff: running a Webflow practice

say: Discovery, pricing and handoff: running a Webflow practice.
This is the video for module 3 of Webflow Development: Consulting, Pricing and Growing Your Webflow Practice.
Most failed website projects fail before the first pixel. The developer built what they assumed, not what the business needed. So start with a 30 to 45 minute discovery call.

panel.heading: Five areas for every discovery call
items: Goal: what should a visitor do?
Audience: who visits, on what device?
Content: text, photos and logo ready?
Updates: what will they change, how often?
Budget and timeline: any fixed launch date?

say: A fixed price only protects you if the scope is written clearly. List what is included.

Then list what is not included. Exclusions prevent most disputes. When the client asks for something new, reply warmly and send a short change order: what is added, the extra price, and how the timeline moves.
Take a deposit before you start. Keep the site on your own workspace, or off the client's domain, until the final milestone is paid.
Confirm every payment in your actual bank or Paystack dashboard. Fake transfer alerts and edited receipts are a known scam.

panel.heading: Protect your money

Confirm in your bank or Paystack dashboard
Never trust a screenshot of a transfer

say: A project is finished when the client owns the site, can update it, and would recommend you. Confirm final payment, then transfer the site.

say: Record a short video on adding a CMS item, and train live while the client does each task. That happy moment is the best time to ask for a testimonial.

say: To remember. Get a signed brief with one measurable goal. Build your price from real hours, and be paid in milestones. Write exclusions and use change orders. Then choose a niche, like schools or clinics, and track your outreach every Friday for 90 days.

panel.heading: Remember
items: One measurable goal and a signed brief

Milestones; confirm payments in your dashboard
Exclusions and change orders protect scope
Choose a niche; track outreach every week
